_note: EXAMPLE. Places where close friends and family live. The hourly alert path watches each one for REAL IMPACT — damage, casualties, evacuations, area-wide health hazards — never for forecasts or warnings. `match` is a case-insensitive regex an item must hit (title + snippet) before it can alert, so a metro-wide feed only fires for the part that matters. `lat`/`lng` drive the USGS earthquake proximity check. `nws` lists the county and forecast zone (from https://api.weather.gov/points/LAT,LNG); only impact-tier NWS products count there. Each place needs feeds in config/feeds.json with `"track": "people"`, `"alert_only": true`, and `"place"` set to the id. Delete both entries and set `places` to [] to turn the feature off.
